title: Normal components after etale pullback
statement:
Let $W\to Y$ be etale with $W$ Noetherian and $Y$
normal integral.
Then $W$ is a finite disjoint union of open-and-closed
normal integral schemes.

proof.text: Let $w\in W$ with image $y\in Y$, and choose affine opens $\operatorname{Spec}A\subseteq Y$ containing $y$ and $\operatorname{Spec}B\subseteq W$ containing $w$ and mapping into $\operatorname{Spec}A$. The restriction $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is etale [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] (being locally of finite presentation, flat and unramified are local on the source and target). Since $Y$ is normal in the sense of [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois], every localization $A_{\mathfrak p}=\mathcal O_{Y,y'}$ is a normal domain, so $A$ is a normal ring. By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-over-normal-ring-normal], $B$ is a normal ring, so $\mathcal O_{W,w}=B_{\mathfrak q}$ is a normal domain. Thus every local ring of $W$ is a normal domain; in particular $W$ is reduced.

Because W is Noetherian, its irreducible components form a finite set by [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-finite-components]. For a point x of W, Spec of its local domain is irreducible, hence so is its image in W. Mathlib Scheme.range_fromSpecStalk identifies this image with the generizations of x. Choose an irreducible component E containing the image. For any component C containing x, its generic point specializes to x and therefore belongs to E. Closedness of E gives C contained in E; maximality gives C = E. Thus distinct components cannot meet. Each component is the complement of the union of the other finitely many closed components, hence is open and closed. Reducedness restricts to these opens, and irreducibility gives integrality. Their stalk maps to W are isomorphisms, which transfer both the domain property and integral closedness, giving normality in the sense of [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois]. Finally enumerate the finite set of components by Fin of its cardinality; their usual covering property gives the supremum equal to top, including when W is empty.

proof_origin.place: Both paragraphs, with the disjointness argument implemented through the irreducible image of Spec of a local domain and generic points, using Mathlib Scheme.range_fromSpecStalk.

lean.statement: theorem Etale.exists_clopen_normal_integral_components {W Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : W ⟶ Y) [Etale f] [IsNoetherian W] (hY : IsNormalScheme Y) : ∃ (n : ℕ) (U : Fin n → W.Opens), (∀ i, IsClosed (U i : Set W)) ∧ (∀ i j, i ≠ j → Disjoint (U i) (U j)) ∧ (⨆ i, U i) = ⊤ ∧ (∀ i, IsNormalScheme (U i).toScheme)
